import AlgebraicJacobian.Projective.EffectiveCartierSupport

/-!
# Generic support of a line-bundle quotient on a curve

A quotient of an invertible module killed by a mono section vanishes at the
generic point. On a smooth integral curve this makes the annihilator support
finite; on a proper curve its schematic support is finite over the field.
For the Grassmannian candidate, producing such a section on each fibre is
still a separate obligation.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
open AlgebraicGeometry

noncomputable section

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules

/-- A closed annihilator support on a smooth integral curve is finite once it
does not contain the generic point. -/
theorem finite_annihilator_support_of_genericPoint_avoidance
    {K : Type u} [Field K] (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsIntegral C.left]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType C.hom] [QuasiCompact C.hom]
    {F : C.left.Modules} [F.IsFinitePresentation]
    (hgeneric : genericPoint C.left ∉ (annihilator F).support) :
    ((annihilator F).support : Set C.left).Finite := by
  letI : IsLocallyNoetherian C.left :=
    LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian C.hom
  letI : CompactSpace C.left :=
    QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace C.hom
  letI : IsNoetherian C.left := { }
  exact Scheme.finite_of_isClosed_of_notMem_genericPoint
    (fun x y h => SmoothOfRelativeDimension.specializes_eq_genericPoint_or_eq C.hom h)
    (annihilator F).support.isClosed hgeneric

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- A mono section of a line bundle killed by a quotient forces that
quotient to vanish at the generic point. -/
theorem genericPoint_not_mem_annihilator_support_of_mono_section
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] {L F : X.Modules}
    (s : (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf : X.Modules) ⟶ L) [Mono s]
    (q : L ⟶ F) [Epi q] (hsq : s ≫ q = 0)
    (hL : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L) [F.IsFinitePresentation] :
    genericPoint X ∉ (annihilator F).support := by
  obtain ⟨U, hηU, hUaff, ⟨eLres⟩⟩ := hL (genericPoint X)
  letI : Nonempty U := ⟨⟨genericPoint X, hηU⟩⟩
  letI : IsAffine U := hUaff
  let unitU : U.toScheme.Modules := SheafOfModules.unit U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf
  let FU := (pullback U.ι).obj F
  let eL : (pullback U.ι).obj L ≅ unitU :=
    ((restrictFunctorIsoPullback U.ι).app L).symm ≪≫ eLres
  let eO : (pullback U.ι).obj
      (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf : X.Modules) ≅ unitU :=
    pullbackUnitIso U.ι
  let jU : unitU ⟶ unitU :=
    eO.inv ≫ (pullback U.ι).map s ≫ eL.hom
  let qU : unitU ⟶ FU := eL.inv ≫ (pullback U.ι).map q
  haveI : Mono ((pullback U.ι).map s) := Functor.map_mono (pullback U.ι) s
  haveI : Mono jU := by dsimp [jU]; infer_instance
  haveI : Epi ((pullback U.ι).map q) := Functor.map_epi (pullback U.ι) q
  haveI : Epi qU := by dsimp [qU]; infer_instance
  haveI : FU.IsFinitePresentation := pullback_isFinitePresentation U.ι F inferInstance
  have hjqU : jU ≫ qU = 0 := by
    dsimp [jU, qU]
    simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc, ← Functor.map_comp, hsq,
      Functor.map_zero, comp_zero]
  have hnot : genericPoint U.toScheme ∉ (annihilator FU).support :=
    genericPoint_not_mem_annihilator_support jU qU hjqU Scheme.isLocallyTrivial_unit'
  intro hη
  apply hnot
  rw [show (annihilator FU).support =
      (annihilator F).support.preimage U.ι.continuous by
    simpa [FU] using annihilator_pullback_support_eq_preimage U.ι F]
  change U.ι (genericPoint U.toScheme) ∈ (annihilator F).support
  rw [genericPoint_eq_of_isOpenImmersion U.ι]
  exact hη

/-- A line-bundle quotient on an integral curve killed by a mono section
has finite annihilator support. -/
theorem finite_annihilator_support_of_mono_section
    {K : Type u} [Field K] (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsIntegral C.left]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType C.hom] [QuasiCompact C.hom]
    {L F : C.left.Modules}
    (s : (SheafOfModules.unit C.left.ringCatSheaf : C.left.Modules) ⟶ L) [Mono s]
    (q : L ⟶ F) [Epi q] (hsq : s ≫ q = 0)
    (hL : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L) [F.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ((annihilator F).support : Set C.left).Finite := by
  exact finite_annihilator_support_of_genericPoint_avoidance C
    (genericPoint_not_mem_annihilator_support_of_mono_section s q hsq hL)

/-- On a proper integral curve, a line-bundle quotient killed by a mono
section has schematic support finite over the ground field. -/
theorem isFinite_schematicSupport_of_mono_section
    {K : Type u} [Field K] (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsIntegral C.left] [IsProper C.hom]
    {L F : C.left.Modules}
    (s : (SheafOfModules.unit C.left.ringCatSheaf : C.left.Modules) ⟶ L) [Mono s]
    (q : L ⟶ F) [Epi q] (hsq : s ≫ q = 0)
    (hL : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L) [F.IsFinitePresentation] :
    IsFinite (schematicSupportι F ≫ C.hom) := by
  have hps : HasProperSupport C.hom F := by
    change IsProper ((annihilator F).subschemeι ≫ C.hom)
    infer_instance
  have hfinite := finite_annihilator_support_of_mono_section C s q hsq hL
  have hfib : ∀ t : Spec (CommRingCat.of K),
      ((schematicSupportι F ≫ C.hom) ⁻¹' {t}).Finite := by
    intro t
    refine (hfinite.preimage
      (isPreimmersion_schematicSupportι F).isEmbedding.injective.injOn).subset ?_
    intro z _
    exact (Set.ext_iff.mp (annihilator F).range_subschemeι
      (schematicSupportι F z)).mp ⟨z, rfl⟩
  haveI : IsProper (schematicSupportι F ≫ C.hom) := hps
  haveI : LocallyQuasiFinite (schematicSupportι F ≫ C.hom) :=
    locallyQuasiFinite_schematicSupportι_comp_of_finite_fibers C.hom F hps hfib
  exact IsFinite.of_isProper_of_locallyQuasiFinite _

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules
